home.aboutBody: Hotarumi lets you track every character you own across multiple gacha games — in one place, on every device. It's a free, multi-game gacha tracker: instead of juggling a spreadsheet or a different app for every game, you keep your whole roster — every character you own, their levels and constellations — synced across all your devices. Build drag-and-drop tier lists, keep them private or publish a shareable link, and compare collections with friends. It works right in your browser, in English and French, with nothing to download.
home.faqA1: Yes — Hotarumi is completely free. Create an account to save your collection and sync it across every device you sign in on.
home.faqA2: Hotarumi currently tracks Arknights, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Wuthering Waves, Genshin Impact and Arknights: Endfield, with more games added over time.
home.faqQ3: Do I need to install an app?
home.faqA3: No installation needed. Hotarumi runs in any modern web browser on desktop, tablet or phone, and your data stays in sync wherever you sign in.
home.faqA4: Your collection is private by default. You decide what to share — publish a tier list as a public link or show your roster on your public profile whenever you choose.
